value.rationale: The canonical self-dual balanced Bier spheres carry a natural signed cyclic symmetry whose freeness has an exact prime/composite boundary. For all odd primes, its full geometric quotient homeomorphism type and torsion profile are identified by explicit lens weights, not only homology ranks. At the first 3D case, a tenfold lens space with a three-tetrahedron model becomes a genuine three-sphere after adding one reflection. This coherent structural and arithmetic classification fills the quotient-topology gap left by prior polytope and sphere-construction work; it is not an arbitrary isolated parameter experiment. The known convex realization and classical proofs are credited.
